provenance.raw_phrase: The following measures will be performed in the course of the study.
The ADAS-Cog (11) is a standard 11-item instrument used to assess word recall, naming objects, commands
The 14 item instrument will be referred to as the ADAS-Cog (14).
Video-referenced Clinician’s Interview-Based Impression of Change (CIBIC+)
vital signs (including supine/standing pulse and blood pressure readings)
Diastolic blood pressure will be measured as the point of disappearance of the Korotkoff
Heart rate will be measured by auscultation.
All patients will be screened by obtaining a 12-lead ECG
ventricular tachycardia at a rate of ≥ 120 beats per minute lasting ≥ 10 seconds
All patients will undergo a 24-hour Ambulatory ECG at Visit 2
sustained ventricular tachycardia with rate > 120 beats per minute
third degree heart block, or sinus pauses of > 6.0 seconds
Blood samples (7 mL) for the determination of xanomeline concentrations in plasma will be collected
